map.SARA是评估小脑性共济失调严重程度的国际标准量表，包含8项检查，总分0-40分: SARA is the international standard scale for assessing the severity of cerebellar ataxia, with 8 items and a total of 0-40 points. The gait assessment requires walking 10 meters on level ground including turning.
map.：8 动作合计 22 /40：明显共济失调，步态与指鼻试验受累重。: The 8 items total 22 / 40: marked ataxia, with gait and finger-to-nose testing heavily affected.
map.：合计 8 /40：轻度，以精细动作不稳为主。: Total 8 / 40: mild, dominated by instability in fine movements.
map.40 分制（步态 8、站立 6、坐位 4、言语 6、其余各 4），越高越差。: 40-point scale (gait 8, standing 6, sitting 4, speech 6, 4 each for the rest), higher is worse.
